last_cycle_basis: Tracker shows a US 'Associate Software Engineer' (Dallas TX / St. Paul MN / Alpharetta GA) first tracked 2024-09-13, now closed; nothing between 2025-07 and 2026-01.
evidence: Pulled Infor's own careers.infor.com/postings.json feed directly (230 postings, all read).
